His business career centred on developing and managing shopping centres across Brazil.

long_biography.plain_text:
Rancho Guanacaste gave shopping-centre businessman Richard Paul Matheson a business with a different purpose. He established the agricultural operation near Uberaba, combining cattle selection, Quarter Horse breeding and coffee production. He regarded the farm as more important emotionally than financially, while still expecting it to support itself rather than serve simply as a weekend retreat.

His property interests later entered a larger corporate structure. When GP Investments and Sam Zell's Equity International invested in ECISA, its former shareholders received direct stakes in BR Malls. Matheson remained a substantial shareholder as the combined business prepared for a public offering, bringing outside capital into the shopping-centre portfolio.
